lines.en: [Your ■■ is approaching.]
A system message ringing in my ears.
I had been hearing it over and over for the past few days.
“It seems there isn’t much time left.”
“No.”
My mother and I sat across the table from each other, drinking tea. For a moment, we watched the panel installed in the [Industrial Complex]’s reception room.
—The American continent destroyed! Where will the ‘Outer Gods’ strike next?
—Emergency evacuation orders issued across Northeast Asia!
—Nebulae abandon Earth. “Nowhere to run, no matter where we flee.”
The news showed the Korean Peninsula last.
The entire peninsula was crowded with refugees from around the world.
I knew very well what they expected to find here.
[The next Great Apocalypse Scenario region is ‘Northeast Asia.’]
[6 days, 8 hours and 24 minutes remain until the Great Apocalypse Scenario begins.]
On the screen, my mother spoke in my place as the [Industrial Complex]’s representative.
The [Industrial Complex] does not turn away new citizens. However…
My mother said with a wry smile.
“It’s embarrassing to watch.”
“It suits you. You look like a president.”
In fact, it would be fair to say my mother, not I, was now the [Industrial Complex]’s master. Its citizens probably followed her more readily than me too.
“Show your face to the people of Seoul before you leave. Even a simple greeting from you will give them a great deal of strength.”
Indeed, I could hear reporters shouting through megaphones outside the [Industrial Complex].
—Demon King of Salvation-nim! Is it true you’ve returned?
—Demon King of Salvation-nim! Please say a few words about your plan to stop the apocalypse!
…A plan.
I smiled wryly, just like my mother.
“If that’s a mascot’s duty.”
Then we sipped our tea.
A dark, murky sky. A lightning strike splitting the peninsula in two at any moment wouldn’t have seemed out of place.
“It’s peaceful.”
“It is.”
Even so, that was what we said.
Tea leaves swayed in the cups. Such a leisurely teatime. It was the first in our thirty-year history as mother and son.
The time we had wanted so much had only arrived now, on the eve of everything’s destruction.
My mother asked me nothing.
What I would do next, what I sought at the end of this story—she asked about none of it. I knew that was her way.
“I’ll be going, then.”
“The ‘Heavenly Wind God’ is looking for you. Be sure to stop by once more before you leave.”
…Pungbaek? Why was he looking for me again?
I remembered the unpleasant incident during the Great War of Saints and Demons. Did he want another round before the final scenario? For now, I nodded lightly and stepped outside.
Someone was waiting for me there.
[You’ve done well to make it this far, Kim Dokja.]
It was Bihyung, looking prosperous since becoming a Great Dokkaebi. The long coat made of white tiger fur suited him rather well.
I asked sarcastically,
“What made you wait for once?”
[The reunion between you and your mother is a popular Story among the subscribing constellations. I couldn’t interrupt the flow.]
Bihyung shrugged and jabbered on.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ dabs at her eyes.]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ grumbles as he hands over a handkerchief.]
Apparently, he had been broadcasting that too. Damn bastard.
[The final scenario is right around the corner now.]
“I know.”
[I’m sure you do. As you know, the final scenario…]
“Bihyung.”
At my words, he stopped and looked at me.
“Why did you choose us?”
A faint ripple passed through Bihyung’s eyes.
I already knew which scenario window would be floating before him now.
<Main Scenario #98—Candidate Vote>
Classification: Main
Difficulty: ???
Clear conditions: Choose the final candidate for ‘A Single Story.’
Time limit: —
Reward: ???
Failure: Death

The <Star Stream>’s scenarios applied not only to constellations and incarnations, but also to the dokkaebi streamers. The ‘Candidate Vote,’ which would decide the scenarios’ final act, was immensely important to them too. A scenario in which they staked their very existence.
And in that scenario, Bihyung had chosen us.
[The Great Dokkaebi ‘Bihyung’ has currently voted for <Kim Dokja’s Company>.]
When I first met him, he had been barely the size of a soccer ball.
A dokkaebi in the sky who indiscriminately slaughtered people and churned out cruel scenarios solely to increase his channel’s subscribers.
That dokkaebi had grown by eating the Stories we made, and had become humanlike. A human’s height. Human clothes. Human expressions.
Now he faced me at the same eye level and spoke.
[Make a contract with me. Then I’ll make you the king of the dokkaebis.]
[That’s what you said to me inside the ichthyosaur’s mouth.]
I had certainly said that once.
“Don’t tell me you really chose me because you believed that nonsense. Our chances of winning are low.”
[That isn’t necessarily true now. You don’t seem to realize the significance of what you’ve done.]
Bihyung turned to look out the window.
In front of the [Industrial Complex]’s plaza, the constellations who had fought beside us against Papyrus were huddled together.

The Black Flame Dragon, pinned beneath Uriel like a cushion. Persephone and Hades, sipping tea at a table they had brought. The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, borrowing what looked like a tobacco pipe from the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint and puffing smoke.
They were watching a live Star Stream broadcast.
—A new list of the ‘twelve great nebulae’ is circulating among the <Star Stream>’s gossipmongers…
—Some Narrative-grade constellations estimate <Kim Dokja’s Company> is already approaching the level of the three strongest (强)…
…The three strongest. It seemed the last battle really had made waves. I appreciated the generous assessment, but it was too early to relax. The Candidate Selection War wasn’t over yet.
Bihyung seemed to judge things differently.
[You should be fine for a while. It’s been two days since you defeated <Papyrus>. Has any other nebula challenged <Kim Dokja’s Company> to a nebula war in that time?]
「A nebula that achieves great results in the Candidate Selection War becomes far more likely to be acclaimed as ‘A Single Story.’」

Just as a single battle had raised us to the top three, the other nebulae could aim to change their rankings through nebula wars. By now, declarations of war and messages announcing war should have been raining down.
But no nebula had even provoked us, let alone declared war.
Earth was astonishingly quiet.
“Why? Our Story can’t have been that amazing.”
[Because you’ll be destroyed even if they leave you alone.]
My heart seemed to turn cold.
I could see the footage playing on the constellations’ panel.
[The constellations know you can’t abandon Earth.]
Apart from the ‘Candidate Selection War,’ Earth had now entered the Great Apocalypse sequence.
North America had been destroyed. Northeast Asia was next.
In the original’s final scenario too, rulers of other worlds, including the Outer Gods, began invading this world.
[The forgotten islands continue to rise!]
「At the worldline’s end, the forgotten beings shall begin their encroachment.」
In the original, the nebulae should have fought alongside me here.
But now, they had made a different choice. Abandon Earth and eliminate <Kim Dokja’s Company>. That was the nebulae’s decision on the eve of the ‘final scenario.’
“Those damned bastards…”
[Some nebulae sneer at your judgment.]
It was fair to call this the worst possible situation.
Even the Outer Gods who had flocked to this world were different from the ones in the original I knew.
I remembered the Uriel of the 999th round whom I had recently seen in ‘N’Gai’s Forest.’
「When the Great Apocalypse Scenario begins, the kings will attack.」
If my prediction was right, all the kings coming in the imminent Great Apocalypse were beings who had seen the ‘Conclusion’ of the 999th round. <Kim Dokja’s Company> would now have to fight them.
“Who summoned the kings? Your Bureau?”
[There’s no information I can disclose. But…]
His face set with firm resolve, Bihyung finished speaking.
[Until my last breath, I will tell your stories.]
“If you don’t want to take part, you can leave now.”
Absurdly enough, those were my first words to my companions.
“The coming scenario will be far more terrible than any decisive battle we’ve experienced. It isn’t too late. If anyone wants to leave the nebula, even now…”

Several companions were yawning, as though sitting through a tedious Mass. Of course they were. Everyone before me had come this far by surviving dozens of brushes with death. Whether they died this way or that, death was death. If they were going to quit now, they would have quit long ago. I knew that too.
But the reason I asked the obvious question, even knowing all that.
“Um.”
There really was someone who wanted to sit out.
“I’ll sit this one out.”
It was Han Myungoh. It wasn’t entirely unexpected.
He continued.
“I don’t mean I’m leaving permanently. There’s just somewhere I need to visit one last time.”
Beside him, Lee Jihye scolded,
“Honestly, ajusshi, just sit out. It’s not as if you help anyway. You’ll run like hell the moment the fighting starts again.”
“…I may be like this now, but I was once a count in the Demon Realm…”
Normally, that routine would have featured ‘department manager at Mino Soft,’ not ‘count in the Demon Realm.’
Watching them bicker, I smiled wryly. In truth, I knew where Han Myungoh wanted to go.
“Are you going where ‘Reincarnation Island’ used to be?”
At my question, Han Myungoh’s expression visibly stiffened.
“Despite the sealing, the effects of the Apocalypse Dragon and ‘The Indescribable Distance’ still linger there. It would be dangerous to go.”
“I still want to go.”

‘Reincarnation Island,’ where the Great War of Saints and Demons had taken place. Even now, dead stars and the corpses of Outer Gods would be drifting in the depths of that dark dimension. Beings who had died without making it aboard the ark.
…Perhaps the demon king ‘Asmodeus’ was among them.
“That child is everything I’ve gained in this world.”
A solemn determination filled Han Myungoh’s eyes.
Since the Great War of Saints and Demons, he had worked hard in our main scenarios. Far harder than when he had stolen his subordinates’ projects to get promoted at Mino Soft.
And he had been rewarded for his efforts. He had obtained small shares in Giant Stories and secured several useful Star Relics.
All to get his daughter back.
As he was now, he might withstand the lingering chaos near ‘Reincarnation Island’ for a few days.
“Go, then.”
Han Myungoh nodded, finished preparing and rose. Apparently, he had already made up his mind. Everyone saw him off.
Not receiving the scenario for ‘A Single Story’ didn’t mean you didn’t have ‘A Single Story.’ Everyone had one. Just as everyone could set out to find their own ■■.
Watching Han Myungoh pass through the portal despite his trembling, I thought again.
[Your ■■ is approaching.]
It wasn’t the <Star Stream> that decided where one’s ‘Conclusion’ lay.
When I turned, my companions were waiting.
“Then let’s continue the meeting.”
[11 hours and 8 minutes remain until the Great Apocalypse Scenario begins.]
Only half a day remained until the Great Apocalypse. We had to survive it to reach the final scenario.

In the meantime, I had checked all the information from the original and asked my companions to collect useful Star Relics and skills remaining around the Korean Peninsula and the rest of Earth. They had readily agreed.
Han Sooyoung asked,
“What are you going to do?”
Of course, I had work to do too.
For example, studying a finishing move with that obstinate bastard.
“As you know, there is only one way for us to fight the Great Apocalypse as we are now.”
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke as he honed the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]’s edge.
Uriel, the Black Flame Dragon, the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal and the other constellations had promised to help, but we couldn’t rely solely on them.

There were four Outer God kings yet to appear, excluding ‘Secretive Plotter.’ If they all came at once, we could never win, even with Myth-grade constellations like the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal or the King of the Underworld.
Fortunately, we had one way to fight back.
「Hell of Eternity」
The Myth-grade Story I had received through ‘Secretive Plotter’ as the reward for the 1863rd round.
Through this Story, I could reproduce Yoo Joonghyuk’s memories, and by sharing the stage of those memories, he could draw on the power of the 1863rd round.
The problem was.
[Reading comprehension has failed!]
[The highest round of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ you can comprehend is the ‘978th round.’]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ regards you as pathetic.]
…Something had gone wrong with my reading.
[Reading comprehension has failed!]
[The highest round of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ you can comprehend is the ‘778th round.’]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ suspects you have difficulty reading.]
Now even a Story was looking down on me.
After this went on for several days, Yoo Joonghyuk finally lost his temper.
“Pathetic. Didn’t you say you’d spent your entire life reading?”
“…Not my entire life. Anyway, this is a different problem.”
I didn’t know why either. Why now, of all times?
“If that’s all you can do, give me the Story. It would be far better if I used it myself.”
“If I could give it to you that easily, I would have done it long ago.”
In fact, I had already asked ‘Secretive Plotter’ how to do it. He had only ignored me.
“Then use that possession skill, like last time. Using the Story with it raises the synchronization rate considerably.”
He probably meant [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint].
“I’d rather not use that if I can help it.”
Certainly, using [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint] would make the Story much easier to use. The skill would produce an effect much like a sponsor controlling an incarnation. But.
“If I use it, my incarnation body becomes defenseless. Winning without it is best, if possible.”
“Pathetic. This is what happens when you neglect your training.”
“…You think everyone can handle your insane training?”
Yoo Joonghyuk glared at me briefly, then returned to the Story without arguing further.
Perhaps he knew too. There was another reason I wasn’t using [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint].
「Not long ago, [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint] had begun disobeying Kim Dokja.」
Sometimes, the skill activated on its own or read someone’s inner thoughts even when I didn’t want it to. I didn’t know why.

Perhaps I had grown too used to looking inside others. Without realizing it, I had become more accustomed to reading someone’s inner world, helpfully laid out in sentences, than listening to what they said.
[Reading comprehension has failed.]
Could my current difficulty reading be the natural consequence of that?
“Concentrate properly, Kim Dokja.”
At Yoo Joonghyuk’s words, I activated the Story again.
Taking a slow, deep breath, I calmly examined my thoughts.
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ begins its story!]
Forget what I know about Yoo Joonghyuk.
I don’t know Yoo Joonghyuk at all.
This guy is someone I know nothing about.
Yoo Joonghyuk isn’t a mad psychopath or an inflexible blockhead.
Thinking that way, my head seemed to clear a little.
Yes, start there. Just like the moment I first read ‘Ways of Survival.’
Ssssspark!
That was when the anomaly occurred.
[A problem has occurred with your reading comprehension!]
Yoo Joonghyuk’s face suddenly went deathly pale.
“Kim Dokja! You bastard, what have you—!”
With those last words, the light left his eyes.
Startled, I asked,
“Hey, are you all right?”
There was no answer to my question.
[The selves of the character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ are colliding!]
His selves were colliding?
Anxiously, I decided to check his condition. But.
[Activation of ‘Character List’ has failed.]
The next sentence was one I had heard a very long time ago.
[This person is not a ‘character.’]
Yoo Joonghyuk had collapsed and still hadn’t woken after four hours.
“Hey! You crazy bastard! Wake up!”
Han Sooyoung and I took turns slapping his cheeks. But he showed no sign of waking.
Slap! Slap! Slap! Slap!
His cheeks were so hard that, even after all that slapping, they hadn’t swollen at all. Instead, my palm hurt. Han Sooyoung spoke with sincere admiration.
“This is kind of fun.”
“…This isn’t the time for that.”
[5 hours and 12 minutes remain until the Great Apocalypse Scenario begins.]
Now there really wasn’t much time left. Soon, the ‘Great Apocalypse’ would begin, and the expanded probability would allow the Outer Gods’ invasion.
And Yoo Joonghyuk was in this state.
I had no idea what had gone wrong.
Was it a problem related to my [Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint]?
[Activation of ‘Character List’ has failed.]
[This person is not a ‘character.’]
I tried [Character List] again, but the same messages appeared.
There were so many Yoo Joonghyuks in this universe, yet that message had only ever appeared for one Yoo Joonghyuk. The Yoo Joonghyuk who had disappeared toward his own story in the 1863rd round…
That brought something to mind. But… Surely not?
Lee Seolhwa, who had been watching us, asked,
“Should we give him a [Life and Death Pill]?”
Not long ago, Lee Seolhwa had finally completed the ultimate restorative, the [Life and Death Pill]. An elixir said to heal any fatal injury as long as it was administered.
“Can you already mass-produce them?”
“No. I’ve only made a few. We’re short of ingredients…”
I let out a low groan. We couldn’t carelessly waste a [Life and Death Pill] when we didn’t know what lay ahead.
[The selves of the character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ are colliding!]
Besides, even with a [Life and Death Pill], I couldn’t be sure it would solve a problem of the self.
Just then, a faint tremor spread throughout the Industrial Complex.
“Dokja-ssi. Movement has been detected.”
The one who hurriedly opened the sickroom door and came in: Lee Hyunsung.
Han Sooyoung and I looked at each other simultaneously. We hastily switched on a panel, which showed the Pacific.
Rrrrummble!
The waves that had swallowed the American continent were appearing again. Blocked by the transparent dome’s walls, the immense waves were only driving the water level higher.
They were still restricted by probability.
Ssssspark!
But the wall of probability was gradually being pushed back. A boundary that grew ever wider across the Pacific. Between the rising waves, I could see ‘Outer Gods’ writhing.
In five hours, that boundary would reach the Korean Peninsula. That very day, this land would disappear from Earth.
“…Kim Dokja. The plan?”
“I have one.”
Glancing at the fallen Yoo Joonghyuk, I added,
“Though I think I’ll have to change it a little.”
“Stop making me anxious. How did they stop that in the original?”
“All the nebulae threw themselves at it. Most of the constellations were ground down stopping it.”
“Where are all those magnificent constellations now?”
“Where do you think?”
[Many nebulae are watching to see what you decide.]
Probably watching our destruction from there.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ condemns the constellations, asking whether all justice in the <Star Stream> is dead!]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ shakes his head with his arms crossed.]
[The constellation ‘Most Ancient Liberator’ finds the major nebulae’s constellations pathetic.]
Despite our constellations’ provocations, the other side remained unruffled.
[Some constellations claim that <Kim Dokja’s Company> caused all of this.]
Some even had the gall to turn the blame on us.
[A few constellations claim that <Kim Dokja’s Company> took their shares first.]
Normally, I would have been outraged at that absurd claim. Strangely, though, I was calm. I thought I understood why they were behaving that way.
When I visited <Oz>, the monkey had told me,

—Many Stories that made up existing Giant Stories are declining in much the same way as <Oz>. Because a certain Story that recently rose to prominence has begun eating into the other Stories’ shares… Your Story.

The leading roles on this stage should originally have belonged to nebulae with long-established myths. But many had lost their main Stories to us or had them destroyed. On top of that, the <Star Stream> had elevated us to the level of the three strongest nebulae. The existing stars must have felt an immense sense of deprivation.
…Of course, that didn’t mean they were doing the right thing.
Biting her nails, Han Sooyoung asked,
“Wouldn’t it be better to just give up Earth? Maybe we should think of a way for all of us to run to the ‘final scenario’…”
“You know we can’t.”
Only those granted permission could enter the final scenario.
Even if we enrolled everyone on Earth in <Kim Dokja’s Company>, they would be caught in the probability backlash from such an absurd scenario jump and perish.
“Damn it…”
I could practically feel [Predictive Plagiarism] spinning furiously in Han Sooyoung’s head.
“You said the ‘Outer God kings’ were from the 999th round. How many are there?”
“As far as I know, four, excluding ‘Secretive Plotter.’”
“…Do we have to fight all four?”
I shook my head and recalled the list of ‘Outer God kings’ I remembered.
「‘The Living Flame’ rising in the east.」
「The calamity of the western world, ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’」
「The ruler of the northern cosmos, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’」
「The one ruling the southern interstellar reaches, ‘King of the Silver Heart.’」
Beings who had seen the ‘Conclusion’ of the 999th round and become ‘Outer God kings.’
But even the <Bureau> probably wouldn’t have deployed every ‘king.’ It didn’t much like uncontrollable scenarios. If so.
“One has already appeared in the Pacific. And once our forces move, another will probably move too. Two in total.”
“One’s that one in the Pacific, and the other’s the Uriel of the 999th round?”
“Right.”
“How strong are they? I saw them then, but only for a moment…”
“The Uriel of the 999th round is why ‘Secretive Plotter’ is in that state.”
“…Shit. And things like that are bringing followers too?”
Han Sooyoung had clearly witnessed the strength ‘Secretive Plotter’ had shown against the Apocalypse Dragon. Her reaction was understandable.
“The constellations in our channel will definitely help, right?”
“Even with their help, victory isn’t certain. Above all, our lineup doesn’t work without Yoo Joonghyuk.”

Originally, I had planned to split our companions into two groups and defeat the ‘Outer God kings’ separately. But without Yoo Joonghyuk, one of our main fighters, we couldn’t borrow the power of the 1863rd round.
Rrrrroar!
On the panel’s screen, I could see the waves gradually expanding their reach.
If we only began defending when the Great Apocalypse’s domain reached the Korean Peninsula, it would already be too late.
I quickly made my decision.
“Let’s move. I’ll tell you what needs doing.”
Five hours remained.
We had to finish every preparation within that time.
While Han Sooyoung passed the plan on to our companions, I met Lee Gilyoung. At my call, he dashed into the reception room, beaming.
“Hyung! You called? What is it?”
I nodded.
“Would you sit there?”
Sure enough, Lee Gilyoung promptly sat on the sofa and looked up at me with shining eyes, as though eager to hear what I would say.
I gazed into his eyes.
「The child who had treated this world like a game.」

The moment I first met Lee Gilyoung was still vivid. The subway’s flickering lights. The nightmare of grasshoppers jumping into the air. If not for the grasshoppers he had caught then, I would have died.
「The insect-collecting boy who lost his mother was now old enough for middle school.」
I hadn’t saved Lee Gilyoung’s mother. What if I had chosen differently that day?

If, for instance, I had hated people a little less. If I hadn’t noticed those wounds on the child’s arm while taking the grasshoppers. If I hadn’t had the habit of assuming someone’s history from a few clues.
If I hadn’t read ‘Ways of Survival.’
If I hadn’t been Kim Dokja—
“…did.”
Huh?
“…I did something wrong, hyung.”
Lee Gilyoung, his head bowed. His shoulders trembling anxiously, as though he were a child awaiting a terrible punishment.
Had my gaze frightened him, or was it something else?
He continued.
“But, but I couldn’t help it… If I hadn’t made that contract then, Shin Yoosung…”
Only then did I understand what he was talking about.
「And to protect what was precious to him, the boy made a contract with a demon.」
Scenes from 『Journey to the West』 flashed before my eyes. I had seen it clearly there. Lee Gilyoung, surrounded by the Lords of Nine Stars, releasing a yellow storm.
That was what he was talking about now.
“I remember you telling me not to use my sponsor’s power, Dokja-hyung! I didn’t break my promise on purpose. I really, really…!”
I rested a hand on the rambling child’s head.
“You did well.”
“What?”
Watching his eyes widen, I continued firmly.
“You did well, Gilyoung. Without you then, we would all have died.”
I knew how hard it must have been for him. I knew too well the sorrow of being unable to do anything while watching companions die before my eyes. Lee Gilyoung must have felt the same.
“But you can’t do that again. You know that, right? With your current strength…”
“What?”
“If the same thing happens again, I’ll do the same. I’ll use that power again. I’ll protect Shin Yoosung… and everyone else.”
“Gilyoung.”
After hesitating briefly, Lee Gilyoung slipped away from my hand. He raised his head, many emotions swirling in his eyes.
Apparently, I wasn’t the only one who had prepared myself.

“I know you called me here to scold me. But I came to say this too. I’m not a little child anymore, hyung. I have that right too. I went through all those scenarios to get here, just like everyone else.”
I groaned inwardly.
I knew that too. I knew, but…
As if finding my thoughts pathetic, the [Fourth Wall] spoke.
「Don’t tre at him like a child. You’re more of a child.」
‘Gilyoung is a child.’
「You can’t fight with out that child any way.」
「Kim Dok ja, acting like a good per son doesn’t suit you.」
I knew.
But even so…
「Don’t wor ry. My friend will help.」
…Friend?
Just then, with a crackle, something like a transparent wall rippled around Lee Gilyoung.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ is responding to its friend.]
I carefully reached into the air.
Something was there. The texture of a Wall I already knew. But a Wall still incomplete.
Suddenly, several things made sense to me.
…So that was it. That ‘Wall’ from back then, to this child…
“H-hyung, no matter how much you try to stop me…!”

Perhaps intimidated by my hand reaching into the air, Lee Gilyoung cried out shakily. I quickly lowered my hand and took his. I held it firmly for a long time. Until, at last, his trembling slowly subsided.
“You’re right, Gilyoung.”
“…Hyung?”
“I… We can’t see the ending without your help. You have an indispensable role in the scenario we’re heading into.”
I slowly closed my eyes and opened them again.
Now, there was no helping it. I too had to acknowledge this reality in which we had no choice but to rely on a wounded child.
I had to cherish a heart that had grown beyond its years, and the courage the child had offered first.
To answer that courage, I had to be honest too.
“But that doesn’t mean I’ll let you fight alone. That’s my selfishness, and something I’ll never compromise on. Can you understand, Gilyoung?”
Lee Gilyoung nodded slowly. Wiping his tears, he even gave a shy smile.
The thought of having to wage war alongside this child hurt all over again.
But now it was time to choose.
“I want to speak to your sponsor.”
At my words, Lee Gilyoung’s gaze suddenly wavered.
“…But hyung, this one…”
“Don’t worry.”
The reason I hadn’t used Lee Gilyoung’s sponsor until now.
The sponsor was far too dangerous.
「“…Are you really not coming with me? You’ll get stronger much faster with me than with him. You still won’t come?”」
Yoo Joonghyuk had probably tried to take Lee Gilyoung with him because he knew that too.
Sly bastard.
Lee Gilyoung was worried. I lightly gripped his shoulder and spoke.
“Your hyung’s a Myth-grade constellation now.”
Until a few days ago, I too would have avoided this choice if possible. But now, things were different.
I took a light breath, looked up and released my True Voice.
[I know you’re watching. Come out.]

The moment my tone changed, a heavy resonance spread. Sparks filled the reception room, and Lee Gilyoung’s expression changed. His eyes twisted in pain and turned white. Realizing what was about to happen, I pushed through the backlash and firmly gripped his shoulder.
[I didn’t tell you to descend.]
Ssssspark!
The backlash diminished in an instant, and pain flooded my arm. I endured it. Without putting on at least this much of a show, I wouldn’t be able to negotiate properly with them.
[Your Status suppresses the effects of the localized backlash!]
Lee Gilyoung’s rapidly calming expression.
Then, through his mouth, filled with empty darkness, came something like the sound of insect wings.
[I am accustomed to waiting, but you are taking far too long.]
A voice like millions of locusts rushing in at once.

It had grown dark outside the window. I thought the sun was setting, but a closer look revealed swarms of insects clinging to the glass. Grasshoppers crawled rapidly, moving their antennae as they stared at me.
Glancing at the swarm, I spoke.
[Compared to how long you’ve waited until now, that should have been nothing. You’re being dramatic.]
[What… do you know… of waiting?]
The words broke off repeatedly. A True Voice that seemed to echo from beneath an emptiness I couldn’t fathom. The surrounding air grew hot with pitch-black Status. I controlled my energy and spoke.
[At least I know you’re a ‘forgotten evil.’]

Reaching the very summit a human could attain and surpassing even her own sponsor, Lee Jihye finally becomes a god of the sea.
「At least at sea, I was confident I could hold my own against any Myth-grade constellation.」
Lee Jihye had actually said that, and had proven it too. In the original novel, she had once fought Poseidon, a Myth-grade constellation, on equal terms at sea.
“Fire!”
[The effects of the attribute ‘Monarch of the Great Sea’ are activating!]
A storm swept in behind Lee Jihye. Tidal waves split apart wherever she passed, and winds of fire poured through. The gale raged as though escorting her ship.
At the head of those winds, Lee Jihye kept firing.
[The exclusive skill ‘Ghost Fleet Lv.???’ continues to return fire!]
And little by little, the wall of waves began to split.
【Mon arch of the Great Sea】
【Twotwotwotwotwotwotwotwotwo】
Even the ‘Outer Gods’ following the enemy seemed flustered.
「The Monarch of the Great Sea does not lose at sea.」
That was an established truth of ‘Ways of Survival.’ I believed that sentence too, and that belief had brought me this far. But.
“Kh…”
With a wet hiss, blood spurted from Lee Jihye’s nose and mouth. Her violently boiling magic power was flowing backward. Worse still.
[The effects of the attribute ‘Monarch of the Great Sea’ are activating!]
That message hadn’t been produced by our side’s Status.
Something seemed to charge at us, and in an instant a headwind flipped my vision upside down. Caught in an enormous tidal wave, the [Ghost Fleet] and the [Turtle Dragon] floundered in the foam.
“Jihye!”
I caught Lee Jihye’s wrist as she flew away like a kite with its string cut.
Roused by my magic power, Lee Jihye somersaulted through the air and landed on the deck.
Grinding her teeth, she seized the helm and shouted.
“I told you to run!”
“We can’t do that.”
The current Lee Jihye couldn’t manage this alone. Even though she had become the ‘Monarch of the Great Sea,’ her opponent had attained that Status long ago and become an Outer God.
Tsssss!
A calamity surpassing even Myth-grade constellations under the protection of the Great Apocalypse Scenario. That was what we were fighting.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ is howling in pain.]
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ is resisting the myth!]
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ is revealing its form.]
The three ‘Giant Stories’ began their stories at once.
Team One was using some of our shares in the ‘Giant Stories,’ so I couldn’t draw on all of them. Still, this was enough to provoke the enemy.
【You…】
Had the white flag’s reminder worked?
The emotions carried in that True Voice were different from before.
Tsssss!
[The character ‘Master of the Sunken Island’ is staring at the Giant Stories.]
[‘Disconnected Film Theory’ is activating!]
At last, the moment I had wanted arrived. The Stories built by the two Lee Jihyes collided, and the disconnected films began to join.
If all went according to plan, this phenomenon would buy us a little time.
That was when the scene before my eyes changed.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ begins its story.]
「This is the Story of Dokja, an only child (獨子).」
「[Please live.]」
「“Ajusshi! No! Stop! Stop—!”」
The memory of our first confrontation with ‘The Indescribable Distance.’
As though even remembering it hurt, Lee Jihye turned her eyes away.
…So that was the expression Lee Jihye had worn then.
I remembered that moment vividly too.
To move the entire collapsing [Industrial Complex], I had made a contract with ‘Secretive Plotter’ and held off that calamity.
【You…】
But the face of the Lee Jihye from the 999th round was contorted too. Then another Story unfolded before us.
[The Giant Story ‘Wanderer of the Eternal Horizon’ begins its story.]
It was a Story belonging to the Lee Jihye of the 999th round.
Seoul, ruined by the nebulae’s assault. Fallen companions. The crumbling battlements of a fortress.
Atop those battlements, Yoo Joonghyuk, missing an arm, was staring at the battlefield with his one remaining eye.
「“…This is the only way.”」
A pitch-black aura of chaos rising from Yoo Joonghyuk’s body.
「“Master! Stop! Stop!”」
I recognized the scene at once. This was Yoo Joonghyuk dying in the 999th round.
His soul, left in tatters by repeated ‘Otherworld Pledges’ with an Outer God, was making its final deal.
Seoul sinking deep beneath the sea. Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
「“Survive.”」
Beyond the pale foam, the memories of the 999th round scattered. ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’ Something was flowing from both eyes of that expressionless woman.
A Story that had not vanished even through the ages.
That Story was what had brought her all this way.
“Ajusshi, this—”
When I turned, our Lee Jihye was crying too.
“It’s just…too similar.”
[The two ‘Giant Stories’ are responding to each other.]
They were bound to be similar stories.
「The round Kim Dokja had considered the most perfect was the ‘999th,’ and…」
Because that was the round I had taken as my model.
「That round alone had come closer to the right ending than any other.」
The only round in which it was possible to save everyone and see the ending.
Tsssss!
Through the raging aftershocks, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round was approaching us.
The distance closing, step by step.
I had a bad feeling.
“Ajusshi, get back!”
Sensing danger, Lee Jihye drew her Twin Dragon Sword and charged.
[Instant Kill]. Lee Jihye’s strongest anti-personnel technique. But the flash of light she unleashed was deflected in midair with a harsh crack. Spraying blood, Lee Jihye’s body flew across the deck.
“Jihye!”
Lee Hyunsung, who had been standing ready, caught her in his arms.
The moment I caught my breath, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round was right in front of me.
Just as I began unraveling my Stories to release my Status, a pale, firm right hand seized me by the collar.
【Who…are you?】
…She really did take after her master.
I smiled bitterly.
Whatever the case, being able to talk now wasn’t a bad turn of events.
“My name is Kim Dokja. I’m your master’s best friend.”
【…Best friend?】
The Lee Jihye of the 999th round looked confused.
She was watching the Stories drifting around me.
「“Just before you clash with them, be sure to look at the wall on the left. Then you’ll understand exactly what I mean.”」
「“I taught you those so you could fight the ‘Sasquatches’ in Scenario 28.”」
The Lee Jihye of the 999th round was reading my Stories.
【How can you…】
「“I am Yoo Joonghyuk.”」
【…Master?】
As though overcome by confusion, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round pressed her left hand to her temple. Her eyes were burning ominously.
Rrrrrumble!
Her grip on my collar tightened. The waves of Status constricting my whole body were slowly choking me.
“Wait, let go of this first…!”
【Mastermastermastermastermastermastermastermaster】
The rampaging Outer Gods echoed her words. In the saddest language in the world, they howled on behalf of the Lee Jihye of the 999th round.
As though their throats would burst. As though their very existence would fade.
[The exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ activates!]
[All your Stories are synchronizing with the character.]
[Your understanding of the character is rising rapidly!]
The moments we had lived flickered across her eyes.
<Demon King Selection>, <Gigantomachia>, <Great War of Saints and Demons>, and <Journey to the West>. And.
[The Story ‘The Square Circle’ is beginning its story.]
「“You can talk anytime. If you don’t want to talk to me, someone else is fine. But don’t curl up alone and let it fester inside.”」
I saw the face of the Lee Jihye from the 999th round, twisted with deep sorrow.
Why, at this moment, did ‘Secretive Plotter’ come to mind?
「【Why is it you, and not me?】」
What did this story mean to the Lee Jihye of the 999th round—to ‘Master of the Sunken Island’?
Would she hate me too?
The life I had built in this worldline by reading their history—
「I’m envious.」
…What?
Tsssss!
As though looking at something she missed beyond measure, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round slowly brought her hand to my cheek.
Even when people read the same story, each comes away with a different impression.
Some despair at seeing a story they could not achieve, while others find comfort in a sorrow so much like their own.
The problem was where that comfort led.
「I want it.」
Madness began to flow through her eyes, steeped in an ancient grief.
The Lee Jihye of the 999th round slowly turned her head.
Her gaze rested on the fallen Lee Jihye.
「I want to live a life like this too.」
I realized what she was thinking.
[Disconnected Film Theory] was surging. As the Lee Jihye of the 999th round reached out, a torrent flowed from her and enveloped the fallen Lee Jihye. This was dangerous.
[The Stories of the two beings are beginning to resonate!]
With a grinding crack, the Stories of the 999th round began to move. The Stories of the 999th round were swallowing the Stories of this worldline. Horrified, I released my Status.
I had to stop it. I could never let the 999th round devour Lee Jihye—
Krrrrash!
Steel sprouted through the deck in an instant, shielding Lee Jihye and me. It was Lee Hyunsung. But something about the aura of Story in his steel was different. I looked at him.
It was Lee Hyunsung standing there, and yet it wasn’t.
Someone was wielding power through Lee Hyunsung’s body.
[The sponsor of the incarnation ‘Lee Hyunsung’ is protecting you!]
A Status that was in no way inferior to that of the ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’
With a grinding crunch, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round pushed her head through the steel wall. Her face had gone frighteningly rigid, as though doused with cold water.
Lee Hyunsung’s sponsor spoke first.
【Jihye. Our story ended long ago.】
The True Voice of an Outer God.
I knew who he was.
At that moment, Han Myungoh was driving along a dimensional route in an [X-grade Ferrarghini] he had bought with coins borrowed from Kim Dokja. His destination was the sealed ‘Reincarnation Island.’
“Dareum! Answer me if you can hear Daddy! Dareum!”
Han Dareum. That was the name Han Myungoh had given his daughter.
Han Myungoh wandered through the Dark Fault, calling that name.
“Dareum!”
In a warped gap in the darkness, Han Myungoh spotted a familiar hand.

A hand he could never fail to recognize. A hand he had never once let go of until the Demon King took her away. Han Myungoh gripped it tightly and began pulling his daughter’s body out from between the faults. It wasn’t easy. But he couldn’t give up.
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ begins its story!]
The Story of <Kim Dokja’s Company>, which he had borrowed to save his daughter, began its story. Little by little, her body began to emerge from between the faults.
Fortunately, his daughter’s incarnation body was unharmed. But her heart wasn’t beating. Fortunately, he had a single [Life and Death Pill] Lee Seolhwa had given him.
“Dareum! Wake up! It’s Daddy! Daddy’s here!”
Han Myungoh cried out, tears streaming down his face.
How much time passed? At last, Han Dareum opened her eyes. A red glow seeped from them.
[…Well done, my subordinate.]
It wasn’t Han Dareum who had opened her eyes.
[…‘Guidance of the End’ nearly ended in the Great War of Saints and Demons.]
The chilling Status of a Demon King. At Asmodeus’s wild laughter, Han Myungoh fell on his backside.
“G-give me back my daughter! My daughter—”
[Your daughter? Hmm… I’m sorry, but that won’t do. I absolutely need this incarnation body. Instead, I’ll give you something nice as a gift.]
With those words, Asmodeus took a pitch-black eyepatch from inside their clothes.
[The right to witness this worldline’s end together.]
It was an old item passed down among the ‘Guides of the End.’
An item that could be used only on reaching the very threshold of the final scenario.
[Activating the item ‘Relic of the Abyss’!]
An ‘Otherworld Incantation’ that summoned the Outer God dwelling in the abyss—the ‘Demon of 999.’
Watching the surrounding dimensions crumple, Asmodeus burst into wild laughter.
[Metatron! Agares! Demon King of Salvation! This story won’t end the way you think. This story—]
【What’s this?】
When had he arrived? A man was standing behind Asmodeus.
A man shrouded in a pitch-black aura, with bandages wrapped around one arm.
Watching from five or six paces away, Han Myungoh trembled. He, too, knew the man’s face.
The man met Han Myungoh’s gaze and smiled.
【…Did you call me? Hmm… What’s this, a Demon King too? Aha, I get it. This Demon King’s picking on you, right? So you called me to save you?】
[O End! No! It was I, Asmodeus, who summoned you—]
With a sharp swish, the man’s transparent hand seized the back of Asmodeus’s neck. A moment later, he was holding Asmodeus’s soul body in his hand.
【I don’t trust anyone hiding in someone else’s body.】
With a wet tearing sound, Asmodeus’s soul body ripped apart. A single blow, without even time for a struggle. Licking the Demon King’s tattered Story, the man smiled.
【I hate Demon Kings most of all. They copy me. Look! This bastard even has the eyepatch I lost.】

Muttering to himself, the man removed the pitch-black eyepatch from Asmodeus’s eye and put it on. He grinned, apparently pleased with how he looked. Trembling, Han Myungoh looked up at him, cradling his fallen daughter.
【Hey, hey, don’t worry. I’m a little scary, but I’m a decent guy once you get to know me.】
Tapping his bandages, the man spoke.
【Well then…shall we go find our Jihye first?】
